rules: When mstatus.VS is set to Off, any attempt to execute a vector instruction or access a vector CSR shall raise an illegal-instruction exception.
When mstatus.VS is set to Initial or Clean, executing any instruction that changes vector state, including vector CSRs, shall change mstatus.VS to Dirty.
If mstatus.VS is Dirty, mstatus.SD shall be 1.

When the hypervisor extension is present and V=1, an attempt to execute any vector instruction or access vector CSRs shall raise an illegal-instruction exception if either mstatus.VS or vsstatus.VS is set to Off.

When the hypervisor extension is present, V=1, and neither vsstatus.VS nor mstatus.VS is set to Off, executing any instruction that changes vector state, including vector CSRs, shall change both mstatus.VS and vsstatus.VS to Dirty.
